title: Action Registry Schema
description: Defines allowed actions, governance constraints, and runtime routing rules. Registry always wins over payload requests.

registry_version.description: Semantic version of this registry artifact

registry_id.description: Unique identifier for this registry instance

conflict_resolution.description: What Nano does when payload intent conflicts with registry constraints. Default is registry_wins.

degraded_mode_default.description: Default behavior for all actions when system is in DEGRADED_MODE and action has no explicit degraded_mode_behavior

actions.description: Map of action_type string to action policy

action_type.description: Must match the key in the actions map

autonomous_allowed.description: Whether this action can ever execute without human review. False means human review is mandatory regardless of payload.

human_review_required_above_severity.description: Severity threshold above which human review is forced, even if autonomous_allowed is true

requires_safety_layer.description: If true and safety layer is unavailable, execution must block

requires_zone_clearance.description: If true, personnel_nearby must be false before execution is permitted

default_expiry_seconds.description: How long an intent for this action is valid if payload does not specify expiry

max_expiry_seconds.description: Hard ceiling on expiry. Payload expires_at cannot exceed generated_at + max_expiry_seconds.

degraded_mode_behavior.description: What Nano does with this action type when system is in DEGRADED_MODE

registry_wins_over_payload.description: Must always be true. Payload is a request. Registry governs.

audit_required.description: Whether Nano must produce an audit log entry for this action type
